Good to know

Questions, answered.

Is the scan really free?

Yes. Your skin age estimate, Glow Score and all 11 measurements are free. The Full Report is an optional $7.99 one-time upgrade.

What's in the $7.99 Full Report?

Your plan built from your scan and answers: priorities in order, an AM + PM routine with product picks for your budget, ingredient matches, what to skip, and your first two weeks.

Is this medical advice?

No. It's a cosmetic analysis of how your skin looks in one photo. For skin concerns, talk to a doctor or licensed specialist.

What happens to my photo?

It's measured, then deleted. We keep the measurements, not the picture.

Do makeup or lighting matter?

Yes. Bare skin in soft, even daylight gives the clearest read. If a signal isn't clear enough to measure, we leave it unscored rather than guess.

How accurate is it?

Every score comes from multiple measurement methods that have to agree. When they don't, we don't show a number. One photo is a snapshot, not a diagnosis.

Can men use it?

Yes. The scan works for everyone.

Do I need an app or account?

No. Just your phone and a selfie.
